cond_0001.intro: The Manufacturing Associate will work in a production environment at [Location masked] supporting development, clinical, and launch activities. Under general supervision, the employee will perform operations in the Manufacturing area according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying, recommending, and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally work around heavy equipment
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or associate degree and 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience OR High school diploma/GED and 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience
Able to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Able to take direction well, follow documents and policies at all times
Able to take initiative
Creates positive work environment through interactions with team members
Able to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Able to perform the physical movements necessary for daily functions on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off of the ground
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Biology and/or Life Sciences
Mechanically inclined (understanding of repairs, etc.)

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing operations and GMP environments.
cond_0113.responsibilities:
Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying, recommending, and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally work around heavy equipment
cond_0113.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or associate degree and 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience OR High school diploma/GED and 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience
Able to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Able to take direction well, follow documents and policies at all times
Able to take initiative
Creates positive work environment through interactions with team members
Able to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Able to perform the physical movements necessary for daily functions on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off of the ground
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Biology and/or Life Sciences
Mechanically inclined (understanding of repairs, etc.)

cond_0309.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Associate to join our team.
cond_0309.responsibilities:
Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying, recommending, and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally work around heavy equipment

Bachelor's degree or associate degree and around 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience, OR a high school diploma/GED and around 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Ability to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Ability to follow direction, documents, and policies consistently
Ability to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Ability to perform physical movements that may be necessary on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off the ground
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Biology and/or Life Sciences
Some mechanical inclination (familiarity with repairs, etc.)
Willingness to take initiative and identify opportunities for improvement
Contributes to a positive work environment through interactions with team members

cond_0322.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Associate to join our team at [Location masked], supporting development, clinical, and launch activities. Under general supervision, the employee will perform operations in the Manufacturing area according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
cond_0322.responsibilities:
Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and SOPs
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally around heavy equipment
cond_0322.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or associate degree and 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience OR High school diploma/GED and 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience
Able to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Able to take direction well, follow documents and policies at all times
Able to take initiative
Contributes to a positive work environment through interactions with team members
Able to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Able to perform the list of physical movements that may be necessary to perform daily functions on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off of the ground
Bachelor's Degree in Biology and/or Life Sciences
Mechanically inclined (understanding of repairs, etc.)

Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and SOPs
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally around heavy equipment

Bachelor's degree or associate degree and 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience OR High school diploma/GED and 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience
Able to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Able to take direction well, follow documents and policies at all times
Able to take initiative
Contributes to a positive work environment through interactions with team members
Able to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Able to perform the list of physical movements that may be necessary to perform daily functions on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off of the ground
Bachelor's Degree in Biology and/or Life Sciences
Mechanically inclined (understanding of repairs, etc.)

Under general supervision, the employee will perform operations in the Manufacturing area according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
cond_0624.responsibilities:
Hands-on operations: set-up, cleaning, and sanitization of various manufacturing equipment
Preparing buffers/media per defined manufacturing procedures (MPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
Following GMP documents (SOPs, MPs) with strict adherence to safety and compliance
Performing and monitoring critical processes with the ability to perform basic troubleshooting
Performing in-process sampling of equipment and operating analytical equipment
Performing washroom activities: clean small and large scale equipment used in production activities
Maintaining an organized and clean workspace
Working in a clean room environment wearing steel toe shoes, full clean room gowning, hairnet and gloves when performing all work
Initiating quality reports
Drafting and revising documents (SOPs, MPs)
Identifying, recommending, and implementing improvements related to routine functions
Assisting in the review of documentation for assigned functions (equipment logs, batch records)
Performing activities that include periods of rigorous, repetitive work
Working around high-pressure systems and occasionally work around heavy equipment
cond_0624.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or associate degree and around 4 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience, OR a high school diploma/GED and around 6 years of Manufacturing/Operations experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Ability to work in teams to complete operational tasks
Ability to take direction, follow documents and policies, and work collaboratively with others
Willingness to take initiative and contribute to a positive work environment
Able to regularly lift up to 35lbs, push and pull objects that require up to 50lbs of force, and work on your feet for long durations
Able to perform physical movements that may be necessary on the production floor: bending, reaching above the head, climbing, kneeling, squatting, stooping, walking upstairs, and standing on portable stairs or ladders up to 6 feet off the ground
Background in Biology and/or Life Sciences (Bachelor's Degree preferred, or equivalent practical experience)
Some mechanical aptitude or familiarity with basic equipment repairs is helpful
